prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: single finished landscape product artwork for a Discord bot Runtime Hosting service, to be placed in a website product card.
Primary request: create one beautiful, refined, art-directed 3D illustration that immediately communicates a bot running in its own hosted runtime. Absolutely no text or lettering anywhere.
Scene: an airy porcelain-white studio with very pale ice-blue atmospheric depth, seamless floor and a soft luminous halo. One compact premium server appliance, off-white ceramic upper shell and finely brushed aluminum base, three beautifully machined dark horizontal ventilation openings, tiny electric-blue and cyan status lights, sits suspended just a little above a thin translucent rounded-square glass platform. Above the server floats ONE small friendly bot head: polished white shell, glossy obsidian face with two small luminous blue rounded-square eyes, minimal tasteful design. A single delicate blue-tinted glass orbital ring curves behind the head and appliance, elegantly suggesting a continuous runtime. Tiny restrained floating light particles add depth without clutter.
Composition: wide landscape near 16:9, centered sculptural still life, balanced generous breathing room, main bot and server together occupy about 60 percent of image width, fully visible with generous margins. Three-quarter camera, subtle perspective, intimate product photography framing, no excessive empty text column. Upper-left corner mostly quiet so an existing website badge can overlay it.
Style/medium: exceptional premium CGI product campaign, sophisticated industrial design, tactile real materials, subtle surface microtexture, precision reflections, ray-traced soft contact shadows and gentle depth of field, crisp appealing silhouette readable as a small thumbnail. Soft broad key light from upper left, tasteful cyan rim illumination, restrained cool-blue reflected light, natural high contrast between dark glass and white ceramic, uplifting calm premium mood. The image must feel deliberately composed and beautiful, avoid generic stock illustration.
Palette: pearl white, soft silver, obsidian, electric blue #2979ff and subtle cyan. Clean luminous mostly light background, no busy environment.
Constraints: ONE appliance, ONE floating bot head. No text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no UI panels, no symbols resembling written characters, no price labels, no card frame, no outer rounded border. No hands, no humans, no robot limbs, no extra gadgets, no extra servers, no heavy neon haze, no excessive glowing streaks, no cyberpunk city. This is the actual artwork, not a mockup of a website.
